ideas.pitch: A secure medical-data agent platform running on AWS using federated retrieval to assist doctors with clinical guidelines without exposing patient data.
ideas.title: MediGraph AWS: Federated Clinical Knowledge Agent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets the AI for Healthcare domain with strong AWS cloud integration, appealing heavily to the AWS Student Community Day and judges looking for secure, production-grade architectures.

ideas.pitch: An autonomous coding tutor tailored for university labs that watches git commits and automatically generates progressive pedagogical challenges and explanations.
ideas.title: AgentEd: Agentic Software Engineering Mentor for Students
ideas.why_it_could_win: Solves an educational problem with advanced agentic workflows that judges in the AI for Education track will recognize as cutting-edge for modern computer science curricula.

ideas.pitch: An automated compliance checker that analyzes cloud deployment templates against security frameworks using a BPMN-orchestrated agent pipeline.
ideas.title: SecureGuard BPMN: Pre-Deployment AI Risk Auditor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages rigorous compliance auditing workflows that satisfy enterprise judges looking for practical security governance in cloud infrastructures.

ideas.pitch: A high-speed semantic router that directs incoming emergency patient symptoms to the correct specialist department at half the LLM query cost.
ideas.title: SemRoute Health: Training-Free Semantic Triage Router
ideas.why_it_could_win: Demonstrates hard engineering with a training-free exemplar index that slashes latency and cost, a metric judges always reward in high-stakes domains.

ideas.pitch: A cloud-native proctoring assistant that uses lightweight computer vision and local audio classification to flag anomalies without violating student privacy.
ideas.title: SecureClassroom AI: Automated Exam Integrity Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses the intersection of security and education with a privacy-first architecture deployable on AWS infrastructure.
